claim_summary: For each prime characteristic \(p\geq3\), the canonical \(\alpha_p\)-fixed subgroup of the connected Picard scheme of the Hilario–Schröer monomial-cusp curve, and the infinitesimal Picard quotient of the corresponding supersingular contracted-product surface, are both \(\alpha_p^{p-2}\).
integrity: Mathematical argument is given in RESULT.md and supporting exact checker verify_ghost.py. No independent mathematical evaluation or publication-priority certification.
scientific_limitations: Specific canonical alpha_p action, algebraically closed ground field, supersingular elliptic factor; the whole Picard scheme and alternative actions are not classified. Finite-prime tests are corroboration, not universal proof.
title: The infinitesimal Picard quotient of the Hilario–Schröer generalized Igusa surface
